name: equipping-stack-docs
description: Generates project-local documentation skills with version-pinned docs via Context7 - covers new stacks and legacy codebases

interface.shortDescription: Project-local doc skills pinned to the versions your project actually uses
interface.longDescription: Discovers your project's stack (from an approved design, manifests, or the code itself), then generates one documentation skill per technology with docs for the exact version in use - including legacy versions, with evidence-based delta annotations. Powered by the anonymous Context7 REST API.
